title: Construct Binary Tree from Preorder and Inorder Traversal

story.title: Replanting the Orchard from Two Records
story.text: One record lists fruit top-down (preorder), the other left-to-right (inorder). The next preorder fruit is always the root of the current stretch; its place in the inorder record splits the stretch into left and right branches.
story.goal: Rebuild the tree and return its root.
